title: Measuring the quality of retrieval and of the final answer

videos.script: Twenty questions, each with the words a right answer contains. One program asks them all and counts. {{run}} First, did the search find the passage? Here, always, within three. {{recall}} Then, is the reply right? Fifteen times out of twenty. {{correct}} Read the five wrong lines, and none of them is the search's fault. Three are the writer's. One is a refusal that cost an answer. And one is the test being wrong. {{five}} Lower the threshold, and the total stays the same while one refusal turns into a wrong answer. {{compare}} A model can judge paraphrased answers, if you check the judge against a person first. {{judge}} Last, a third of the questions kept aside, run once, and a bar the build must clear. Raise the threshold too far, and the build fails. {{ci}} That is what lets you change anything in the pipeline and know by the evening whether it helped. {{end}}
